text.en:
Melee kills grant <arc/>Amplified, begin Health Regneration, and restore a fixed amount of HP based on <link Combatant Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minor: 50 HP
• Elite: 75 HP
• Miniboss and Bosses: 100 HP
• Players: 30 HP

Breaking a combatant or player shield, or dealing damage to a target below 30% HP, grants <arc/>'Knockout' for 6 seconds.

<arc/>Knockout makes all Unpowered Melees count as Arc-Powered Melees and grants the following benefits:
• <pve 160% /> <pvp [30%] /> Increased Uncharged Melee Damage
• <pve 160% /> <pvp [20%] /> Increased Charged Melee Damage
• Increases Melee Lunge distance against Combatants to 6 meters

<bold/><pvp In PvP Only: /> 
<arc/>Spark of Feedback's damage increase is reduced to 15% while <arc/>Knockout is active.
